    total = 0
    k = 0
    x2 = x * x
    term = scale // x

        t = term // (2 * k + 1)
        total += t if k % 2 == 0 else -t
        term //= x2
        k += 1
    return total

            w = (w << 4) | int(d)
        words.append(w)
